# diffwalk

> Turn AI-generated code changes into an ordered walkthrough, with every explanation attached to its exact diff.

diffwalk is an open-source CLI for coding agents to capture a Git working tree, author a deliberate reading order, and produce a browser-based code review for humans.

## Use diffwalk

Install the CLI:

```sh
npm install --global diffwalk
```

Then tell your coding agent:

> Use diffwalk to explain this change.

The agent runs `diffwalk inspect`, writes the walkthrough in `explanations.yaml`, and validates it with `diffwalk check`. You choose whether to open it locally with `diffwalk view` or publish a share link with `diffwalk publish`.

## Documentation

- [README](https://github.com/minipai/diffwalk#readme): installation, authoring format, commands, exports, publishing, and trust boundaries
- [Agent skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/minipai/diffwalk/main/.agents/skills/diffwalk/SKILL.md): instructions for agents using diffwalk
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/diffwalk): published CLI
- [Source code](https://github.com/minipai/diffwalk): repository and issue tracker

## Example

- [Example review](https://review.diffwalk.dev/r/P_8OK1RGULn2Wx2p6u1LuQ): a guided review of a multi-file code change
